title: Orbital Angular Momentum
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the orbital angular momentum of the neutron pair as L = 1.

title: Total Spin Angular Momentum
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the total spin angular momentum as S = 1.

title: Probability Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate the reasoning leading to the probability of finding both neutron spins opposite the deuteron as zero.

title: Angular Dependence
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the angular dependence of the neutron emission probability correctly as dP/dOmega = (3/8pi) sin^2(theta).

title: Conservation Laws
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply conservation of angular momentum and parity correctly in the analysis.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in angular momentum calculations.

title: Normalization Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include a normalization check for the wave function components.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
